newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: WTO Director-General to sit in on Mercosur meeting.
newsitem.headline: WTO Director-General to sit in on Mercosur meeting.

text.p: The director general of the World Trade Organization, Renato Ruggiero, arrived in Paraguay Tuesday to sit in on talks between leaders of Latin America's Mercosur customs union this week, Paraguay's foreign ministry said.
According to a schedule of events given to journalists by Paraguay's foreign ministry, Ruggiero arrived in Paraguay Tuesday and met with the country's president, Juan Wasmosy.
Ruggiero was due to attend and give a brief speech at a meeting of Mercosur presidents Thursday in Asuncion, said the ministry.
Mercosur groups Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.
On Wednesday Ruggiero will meet with other Paraguayan politicians and business leaders. He will hold a press conference Wednesday afternoon.
